card.name: Linking words in institution and title names
card.fires_on: Small linking words like "of" or "to" right after a department, division or relative noun, and sometimes partway through a name. Mostly in biographies, academic affiliations and reference text.

modes.label: Of in affiliations
modes.description: The word "of" after Division, Department or brother, before a named field or person.
modes.example: Medical Physics Graduate Program, Division<< of>> Pediatric Radiology.

modes.label: Inside names
modes.description: Partway through a proper name or drug name, or a dictionary abbreviation.
modes.example: Early in the 14th century the Turkish tribal chieftain O<<th>>man (Osman) founded an empire
